outcome: duration of active phase of labor
time from analgesia to complete dilation
time from complete dilation to delivery
cohort: 80 pregnant women referring to Najmieh hospital in 2013, with tendency to painless labor
finding: There was no significant difference in the duration of active labor between different types of analgesia, but general anesthesia was associated with a significantly shorter time from analgesia to delivery compared to epidural analgesia.
